title: Hypercontractivity of the Zero Variable
statement: For all real numbers $a$ and $b$, the uniform $L^2$ norm on a one-point space of the function with constant value $a+\tfrac12 b\cdot 0$ is at most the uniform $L^1$ norm of the function with constant value $a+b\cdot 0$.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying space is the one-point space
